title: The Deathray: A simple way for an untrusted site to freeze a Mac
summary: A blog post describing 'Deathray,' a technique allowing an untrusted website to freeze a Mac by exploiting browser or system-level resource exhaustion. The Hacker News discussion (268 points, 192 comments) explores the mechanism, its security implications, and potential mitigations, highlighting ongoing concerns about web-based denial-of-service attacks against desktop operating systems.
